not-content.rule: the namespace of the CSF's own names `risk-party` and `example` (https://csrc.nist.gov/ns/csf)
a back-matter resource that nothing in the document refers to: nobody can reach it, and it is not carried
the id of a statement part is the id of its item and `_statement`
the id of an overview part is the id of its function and `_overview`
the class of an element says on which level it stands (function, category, subcategory); the level is what makes it a function Set, a category Set or a Requirement
the name of a part selects the member its prose is written to (statement, example, overview)
the name of a prop selects the field its value is written to (label, sort-id, status)
